screens.title: How to read this file
screens.purpose: Clickable low-fidelity wireframes for the yeslyf app, v0.2. Grey boxes show what is on a screen and in what order. Nothing here is visual design; that is the studio's job once the flow is agreed.
ui: Left: the journey, section by section. Middle: the screen. Right: what the screen does, its fields with gate, source and precision, its logic, branches, states, dev notes, events and compliance flag, plus your verdict and comments.

Tap any button inside a screen to follow the flow. Use the arrows or your keyboard to step through. Filters at the top: tier (DIY, DIWM, DIFM), path (aa, manual, both), state (pick a returning-user state to see its landing and its home variant), compliance (flagged screens only, by reason), template (one layout at a time, for the studio's count).

Every touched screen carries a marker, Changed in v0.2 or New in v0.2, with its cause: a brief item, a review row, or the post-meeting decision date. Dropped screens are listed on the Changelog tab and never drawn.

Comments save in this browser as you type and write to the v02_comments sheet tab when the endpoint is set. Pick your name, or Spinach or Compliance, before commenting. Export downloads a markdown build brief.
DIY: app only, calls a la carte
DIWM: same app plus included adviser calls
DIFM: existing House of Alpha clients; app for data and dashboard, advice off-app
Two SKUs, DIY and DIWM, each billed monthly or quarterly; no one-time card, no credit rule, no one-time state

Calls: included calls per SKU per period are config, never a drawn number or length; a call is a call, with a topic; any adviser from the call centre takes any call; a la carte calls for anyone on any SKU; bookable at any time, before or after the plan
No named adviser on any screen; a config flag, adviser continuity (off by default), lets the same adviser be offered again
DIFM: not a shown SKU, no in-app upsell; DIFM clients exist in the app for tracking only; prospects are flagged in the CRM and called by the call centre
Holdings that are not AA-fed or CAS-verified: G11 renders, G12 is a locked card with two unlock actions, G13 gives buy advice for new money only
Why the data spine was rebuilt

v0.1 bug, flagged by the studio: the manual branch (A05 Do it manually instead, to D02) never asked a manual user for bank balances, deposits, mutual funds or stocks, and skipped D01; A09's CAS button linked to itself and no upload screen existed
About 60 percent of the fields the plan needs are manual for every user, AA or not. The manual path is the main road; AA prefills one lane and, more importantly, keeps the plan current afterwards
Standing rules for every D screen

1. One spine, both paths: AA users arrive prefilled and tagged AA-fed, CAS users with holdings tagged CAS-verified, manual users with empty fields; no screen is bypassed on any path; order D01, D08, D09, D05, D06, D02, D03, D04, D07, D10
2. One question per screen for numbers; taps may auto-advance; list items get a list screen plus a detail screen per item type; every instance is its own screen ID with a template tag

3. Band rule: every band question shows a visible exact input; a tapped band prefills the exact field with the midpoint; exact removes the approx tag; bands are dynamic by income tier with midpoints from L02; each field is exact-first or band-first

4. Readback and units: every amount shows a readback in words, a per-month or per-year toggle where either applies, L and Cr multipliers and the numeric keypad; plausibility checks against the reveal prompt a check, never a block
5. Hesitation detection: at 45 seconds a warm line (D11a), at 90 seconds the why-this-matters line (D11b), at 120 seconds or on a second return the skip offer (D11c); copy slots only

6. Tri-state fields: value, explicit none, not sure; None chips set explicit none; Not sure yet, skip sets not sure; not sure is never stored as zero; blindspot and concern copy fires on explicit none only; not sure produces a verify action

7. Gate and sharpen: each field carries gate true or false; the plan builds when every gate field is value or explicit none; sharpen fields appear inside the plan section they improve as Sharpen this links that reopen the single screen and re-run

8. Capture ladder: under the exact input and the bands, the lower-friction sources for that item, in order where they apply: AA, CAS upload, guided lookup, document to the Vault, then Not sure yet, skip; no partner ask anywhere

9. Source and precision tags on every field: source aa, cas, manual or assumed; precision exact, approx or unknown; D10 and every G screen show them; a manual override locks the field against AA refresh
10. Section micro-feedback: after the last screen of each spine section, one card in the adviser voice, chosen by the answers, no numbers (D12a to D12h); copy slots only
11. Endowed progress: the ring starts at 20 percent after the reveal, weighted gate fields first; minutes are about N minutes
12. Exit from any D screen: autosave, then O03 When will you finish; the chosen time replaces the first scheduled nudge and the standard ladder follows
13. Events and compliance flags on every screen (appendices D and G)
If fewer than 70 percent of paid users in the January beta reach the gate within 7 days, the gate list is cut again before the studio starts screens
The v0.1 wireframe and admin files are served byte-identical under v01/
The Meeting, Gaps and Inputs tabs are frozen as of 9 Sep 2026; decisions are shown on them and their controls are disabled
